No trustworthy GROSS prior year reserve movement or opening gross claims outstanding could be identified; therefore those fields are null. If higher-fidelity images or the original PDF are provided, I can extract the requested reserve figures, the movement note, claims triangle, and the segmental premium breakdown exactly.
